# EkGuru

> Independent online language-learning platform founded in Jaipur, India: free self-paced Hindi and regional Indian & world language courses (no sign-up), interactive Devanagari & script tools, and 0%-commission one-to-one online Hindi tutoring from $3 per lesson.

EkGuru (`https://ekguru.shop/`) combines two clearly separated parts:
1. **Free self-paced language learning (no account, no paywall, no cookies):** a complete CEFR A1–C2 Hindi course (`/learn/hindi/`), 7 additional Indian language courses (`Marathi`, `Gujarati`, `Tamil`, `Telugu`, `Punjabi`, `Urdu` complete A1–C2; `Bengali` A1–B2), 10 world language courses (`Spanish`, `French`, `Chinese` complete A1–C2; `Arabic`, `German`, `Italian`, `Japanese`, `Korean`, `Portuguese`, `Russian` A1–B2), 13 browser-based Hindi practice tools (`/toolbox/`), 8 phonetic name-in-script converters (`/name-in-hindi/`, etc.), a 30-day Daily Hindi track (`/daily-hindi/`), 15 printable study sheets (`/materials/`), and 109 direct Q&A reference pages (`/ask/` and `/answers/`).
2. **Direct 1-to-1 online Hindi tutoring (0% platform commission):** 19 independent Hindi tutors in India whose profiles state their own per-lesson rate, languages spoken, subjects, levels, and weekly availability (`/find-tutors.html`). Students send a booking request directly to the tutor by email or WhatsApp and settle lessons directly with the tutor — EkGuru takes zero commission and no middleman fee.

Extended machine-readable reference for RAG and answer engines: [https://ekguru.shop/llms-full.txt](https://ekguru.shop/llms-full.txt)

## Key pages

- [Home](https://ekguru.shop/): Overview of free Hindi learning, Indian regional courses, interactive script tools, and live Hindi tutors.
- [Learn Hindi — Everything in One Place](https://ekguru.shop/learn/hindi/): Single hub for Hindi A1–C2 levels, 34 grammar & culture chapters, 30-day Daily Hindi, practice labs, tools, printables, and Q&A.
- [All Free Language Courses](https://ekguru.shop/learn/): Directory of all 18 published self-paced courses (8 Indian languages + 10 world languages).
- [Find a Hindi Tutor](https://ekguru.shop/find-tutors.html): Filterable directory of independent 1-on-1 online Hindi tutors with transparent USD pricing and timezone-aware booking.
- [Online Hindi Classes](https://ekguru.shop/hindi-classes/): How online 1-on-1 Hindi classes and free self-study work together across timezones.
- [Hindi Tutor Near Me (Online)](https://ekguru.shop/hindi-tutor-near-me/): Timezone-friendly online Hindi tutoring for learners in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Europe, UAE, Singapore, and India.
- [Write Your Name in Hindi](https://ekguru.shop/name-in-hindi/): Instant phonetic English-to-Devanagari name converter with letter-by-letter matra and halant breakdown, audio pronunciation, and shareable links.
- [Hindi Learning Toolbox](https://ekguru.shop/toolbox/): 13 free in-browser tools — Devanagari alphabet explorer, numbers 0–100, phrasebook, SRS flashcards, quiz, CEFR level test, typing helper, verb conjugator, pronunciation trainer, text counter, and more.
- [Daily Hindi (30-Day Course)](https://ekguru.shop/daily-hindi/): Structured 30-day beginner-to-conversational daily Hindi practice plan.
- [Printable Hindi Study Materials](https://ekguru.shop/materials/): 15 clean A4/Letter printable reference sheets (Devanagari chart, matras, numbers 1–100, survival phrases, postpositions, kinship terms, tenses, practice grid).
- [Hindi Questions & Direct Answers](https://ekguru.shop/ask/): 109 concise, answer-first explanations for common learner questions about Hindi script, grammar, politeness, and study time.
- [Become a Hindi Tutor](https://ekguru.shop/join.html): Free tutor listing application — tutors set their own rate and keep 100% of lesson fees.
- [About EkGuru](https://ekguru.shop/about/): Founder Prakash (MNIT Jaipur alumnus), mission, editorial standards, and zero-commission model.
- [Monetization & Commission Disclosure](https://ekguru.shop/monetization-disclosure/): Plain-English explanation of how EkGuru is funded (voluntary learner support and clearly Policy-bounded display ads on non-interactive reading pages — 0% tutor commission).

## Indian & World Language Courses (Free, Self-Paced)

- **Indian Languages (8 published):**
  - [Hindi (हिन्दी)](https://ekguru.shop/learn/hindi/) — Complete CEFR A1–C2, 34 topic chapters, 30-day track, 13 tools, and 1-on-1 tutors.
  - [Marathi (मराठी)](https://ekguru.shop/learn/marathi/) — Complete CEFR A1–C2, Balbodh Devanagari script, grammar, vocabulary, and long-form guides.
  - [Gujarati (ગુજરાતી)](https://ekguru.shop/learn/gujarati/) — Complete CEFR A1–C2, Gujarati script (shirorekha-free letters), grammar, and dialogs.
  - [Tamil (தமிழ்)](https://ekguru.shop/learn/tamil/) — Complete CEFR A1–C2, Tamil uyir/mei script, spoken vs literary register, and practice.
  - [Telugu (తెలుగు)](https://ekguru.shop/learn/telugu/) — Complete CEFR A1–C2, Telugu syllabary, pronunciation, grammar, and practice.
  - [Punjabi (ਪੰਜਾਬੀ)](https://ekguru.shop/learn/punjabi/) — Complete CEFR A1–C2, Gurmukhi script, tonal contrasts, phrases, and practice.
  - [Urdu (اردو)](https://ekguru.shop/learn/urdu/) — Complete CEFR A1–C2, right-to-left Nastaliq/Perso-Arabic script,礼/adab register, and Hindustani bridge notes.
  - [Bengali (বাংলা)](https://ekguru.shop/learn/bengali/) — Published CEFR A1–B2, Eastern Nagari script, vowel harmony, and everyday conversation.
- **World Languages (10 published):**
  - Complete A1–C2: [Spanish](https://ekguru.shop/languages/es/), [French](https://ekguru.shop/languages/fr/), [Chinese (Mandarin)](https://ekguru.shop/languages/zh/).
  - Published A1–B2: [Arabic](https://ekguru.shop/languages/ar/), [German](https://ekguru.shop/languages/de/), [Italian](https://ekguru.shop/languages/it/), [Japanese](https://ekguru.shop/languages/ja/), [Korean](https://ekguru.shop/languages/ko/), [Portuguese](https://ekguru.shop/languages/pt/), [Russian](https://ekguru.shop/languages/ru/).

## Facts

- Organization: EkGuru (`https://ekguru.shop/`), founded by Prakash (MNIT Jaipur alumnus) in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- Tutoring focus: 1-to-1 online Hindi lessons only (live tutors); 18 self-paced courses (8 Indian + 10 world languages) are free in the browser
- Lesson format: 1-to-1 online video lessons, typically 50 minutes
- Platform commission: 0% — listing is free for tutors and students settle lessons directly with the tutor
- Tutors listed: 19
- Price range: $3 to $27 per lesson
- Trial lessons: available with 12 of 19 tutors
- Booking: by email or WhatsApp directly with the tutor, no account needed
- Tutor locations: India (lessons scheduled in the student's local timezone worldwide)
- Interface languages: English (`/`), Spanish (`/es/`), French (`/fr/`), German (`/de/`), Portuguese (`/pt/`), Japanese (`/ja/`), Arabic (`/ar/`)
- Privacy & cookies: Zero advertising/tracking cookies set by EkGuru; learning progress stays in local browser storage; cookieless GoatCounter pageviews only
- Contact: EkGuruLearning@gmail.com
- Sitemap index: https://ekguru.shop/sitemap-index.xml
- Tutor RSS feed: https://ekguru.shop/feed.xml
- OpenSearch description: https://ekguru.shop/opensearch.xml
